⚠ Both claude.ai and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set · auth may not work as expected
  · to use claude.ai: Unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or turn off "Use custom API key" in /config.
  · to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: claude /logout to sign out of claude.ai.

❯ Call the AskUserQuestion tool exactly once with exactly one question: header "Fruit", question "Which fruits do you
  like?", multiSelect true, options "Apple" (description "Crisp"), "Banana" (description "Soft"), "Cherry" (description
  "Small"). Do nothing else.

⏺ Declined to answer Claude's questions:
  ⎿  · Which fruits do you like? (Apple / Banana / Cherry)

❯ Call the AskUserQuestion tool exactly once with exactly two questions in one call. Question 1: header "Size",
  question "Which size?", multiSelect false, options "Small" (description "Fits one"), "Large" (description "Fits
  two"). Question 2: header "Toppings", question "Which toppings?", multiSelect true, options "Cheese" (description
  "Melted"), "Olives" (description "Black"). Do nothing else.

⏺ Declined to answer Claude's questions:
  ⎿  · Which size? (Small / Large)
     · Which toppings? (Cheese / Olives)

❯ Call the AskUserQuestion tool exactly once with exactly one question: header "Colour", question "Pick a colour",
  multiSelect false, options "Red" (description "Choose Red"), "Green" (description "Choose Green"), "Blue"
  (description "Choose Blue"). Do nothing else.
